* '''GPN category:''' Standard

== Strategy ==

Oops meant to put in they must never again leave this city, Ozzel is cool and bast gets the new V-Card weapon

Ok start Blaster Rack, Mob Points/YCHF and I'm Sorry, use mob points for the Executor then pitch the effect for combat response.  Use twi'leks to get they must never again leave this city.

Its just like any old skool Dark Deal but now you use the repeating weapons and DR. E and The Weather Vane to Do some major damage to the laast man standing, combined with breif loss of control you can bring a huge Beatdown.

I will add more stratedgy later maybe but E-Mail me with suggestions
